deadline.value: Priority deadline for Fall is January 15; later applications are accepted with a lower chance of admission.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required but is strongly recommended.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general and subject test in physics or chemistry) are not required, but strongly recommended.

gre_subject.value: The general and physics or chemistry subject GRE are strongly recommended, not required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores (general and subject test in physics or chemistry) are not required, but strongly recommended.

supervisor.value: Applicants are asked to name three to five faculty they want to work with, which is advised but not required.
supervisor.quote: Students should identify 3-5 faculty who they are interested in working with based on their and the faculty’s research interests.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student receives a teaching or research assistantship.
funding.quote: graduate assistantships are awarded to all admitted PhD students in the form of teaching or research assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants with a bachelor's degree or higher can apply; the page also gives a separate credit path for master's holders.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university | Minimum Total Credit Hours for Post-Master's Students

notes: Program page and admission page both give the January 15 deadline. Admission is by background review; the page says there is no conditional admission.
